artifacts.summary: Research for the nomic operator and its three results: all six deliverables machine-checked sorry-free in nine lean_run_code probes, with a two-directory siting recommendation (Semantics/Nomic/Uniformity.lean plus a new NomicLanguage/ component), a seven-phase decomposition, the five required paper-record rows with resolved sha256 values, and the zero-warning-budget and task-801 territory hazards.
